paras: Ichnotropis  chapini is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is native to Central Africa.
The specific name, chapini, is in honor of American ornithologist James Paul Chapin.
I. chapini is found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and South Sudan.
The preferred natural habitat of I. chapini is savanna, at altitudes of 1,100–1,200 m (3,600–3,900 ft).
